purpose: Allow explicitly parallel research, replication, or audit executions for one task without weakening per-execution ownership. Ordinary tasks keep one default execution lane; parallelism is opt-in through an immutable cohort whose lanes write to disjoint output namespaces and later feed the parallel-evidence two-pass synthesis layer.

claim_extension.publication_id: must equal the publication pinned by the lane
claim_extension.allowed_outputs: must remain within the lane output_prefix

result_extension.rule: cohort/lane identity is copied from the accepted claim into durable execution provenance and result records; it is never inferred from timestamps

output_namespace_rule: Active lanes in the same task may not use equal, ancestor, or descendant output prefixes. Create a new lane-specific directory instead of sharing a mutable output location.
completion_rule: A cohort may close execution lanes, but task-level terminalization remains a separate synthesis/control decision over the complete parallel evidence set.

interaction_budget.cohort_open: one immutable cohort record only when parallel execution is intentionally requested
interaction_budget.per_lane_claim: one ordinary Issue #240 CLAIM per lane
